The issuer displays very strong profitability, with quarterly revenue of $20.88B, an 85% gross margin, and $6.6B in operating income. However, its balance sheet exhibits highly leveraged characteristics, featuring a very low current ratio of 0.35 (current liabilities of $159.6B vastly exceeding current assets of $56.5B) and total liabilities representing nearly 89% of total assets. While its massive operating scale and earning power support an investment-grade profile, the substantial short-term refinancing needs and leverage constrain the rating.

DECISION: BBB-
